summary: Iteration 57 — Re-verification of the 3 fixes applied for iter56 failures on EuroMatchTickets. (1) BreadcrumbSchema imports were auto-injected in ComparisonPage.jsx / EventsThisWeekendPage.jsx / MonthlyEventsPage.jsx / PriceGuidePage.jsx — VERIFIED (all 4 files contain `import BreadcrumbSchema`). (2) CityDemandPage.jsx now uses useEffect to set document.title / meta / canonical / og:image — VERIFIED (`/concerts-in-london-2026` now renders title 'Concerts in London 2026 — Full Schedule & Cheap Tickets | EuroMatchTickets' with 151-char description, 5 valid JSON-LD blocks, 0 JS errors). (3) ComingSoonEvent.jsx same useEffect pattern — VERIFIED (`/taylor-swift-london-tickets` now renders title 'Taylor Swift London — No Dates Confirmed Yet | Get Notified' with robots='noindex, follow' as intended, canonical correct, 4 valid JSON-LD blocks, 0 JS errors). Backend: 52/52 pytest pass (robots.txt, sitemap-index with 9 sub-sitemaps, 30 sampled URLs across events/worldcup/f1 sitemaps all 200, all 47 key routes return 200). Frontend Playwright audit with Googlebot UA on 47 routes: 39/47 clean (83%), 8 routes have pre-existing issues NOT addressed by iter57 fixes — see frontend_issues.

minor.issue: Returns 401 on anonymous pageview producing console noise (pre-known from iter56, non-blocking for SEO).

ui_bugs.issue: React 19 hydration error 'In HTML, <span> cannot be a child of <tr>' and '<span> cannot be a child of <tbody>'. This was flagged in iter56 for 3 pages; iter57 audit finds it also on /f1-2026-schedule and /f1-monaco-grand-prix-tickets. Root cause: a component (likely BreadcrumbSchema or a JSON-LD script wrapper) rendered as a direct child of <tbody>, OR a <span> used as a placeholder cell instead of <td><span>. Must locate with `grep -n 'tbody>{' -n 'tr>{' src/pages/` and wrap in <td> or move outside <table>.
ui_bugs.selector: table tbody > span, table tr > span (direct child)

ui_bugs.issue: No <script type=application/ld+json> present on page. All other world-cup-2026-* routes have JSON-LD. Missing structured data hurts SERP enhancement.

Page loads with title but triggers 2x 'Failed to load resource: 404' errors in console during hydration. Soft-404 concern was already flagged in iter56. Either add a proper React route + page component, or remove from sitemap, or serve with noindex.

Both load fine but trigger 2x 'Failed to load resource: 404' console errors during hydration — likely a missing image or API asset. Non-blocking for title/meta but adds console noise Google may flag in Search Console.

action_items: FIX (HIGH, carried over from iter56 and expanded): <span> direct child of <tr>/<tbody> hydration errors on 5 pages — /f1-ticket-prices-guide, /how-to-buy-f1-tickets, /motogp-2026-schedule, /f1-2026-schedule, /f1-monaco-grand-prix-tickets. Grep `src/pages/F1TicketPricesGuide*.jsx`, `HowToBuyF1*.jsx`, `MotoGPSchedule*.jsx`, `F12026Schedule*.jsx`, `F1MonacoGrandPrix*.jsx` for pattern `<tbody>` followed by anything other than `<tr>`, or `<tr>` followed by anything other than `<td>/<th>`. Likely a stray BreadcrumbSchema or JSON-LD <script> placed between <tbody> and the first {rows.map(...)} — move it OUTSIDE the <table>.

critical_code_review_comments: iter57 fixes (CityDemandPage + ComingSoonEvent useEffect) now write directly to document.head. This bypasses React Helmet and the pre-hydration map, which is pragmatic but creates a THIRD pattern for SEO meta in the codebase (pre-hydration map in public/index.html, SEOHead.jsx component, direct DOM useEffect). Strongly recommend consolidating into a single reusable `useSeoMeta({title, description, canonical, ogImage, robots})` hook so the pattern is consistent for future pages.

The BreadcrumbSchema missing-import bug (iter56) was caused by adding <BreadcrumbSchema> JSX without the import statement — happens because the component is copy-pasted across pages. Add an ESLint rule `no-undef` (already default) and make sure it runs in CI; or switch to barrel exports so BreadcrumbSchema is always in scope via a single `import * from '../components'`.

47 routes all return HTTP 200 via SPA catch-all even when no React route is defined. /concerts-in-paris-2026 is a soft-404 example. Consider adding a server-side 404 check against the known route registry, returning a real 404 status for undefined paths to avoid Google indexing thin/duplicate pages.
